title: Cluster expansion-accelerated exploration of the surface structure properties of a PdPtAg ternary alloy for the oxygen reduction reaction across the compositional space
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36103-36115
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05089H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Minghao Hua, Shuo Li, Xuelei Tian, Xiaohang Lin, Guoxiang Li
The amount and distribution of dopant metals Pt and Pd in the ternary alloy Pd/Pt/Ag can be controlled by adjusting the temperature; the atomic distribution can be observed using the cluster expansion with Monte Carlo simulations.
